'''Michael Fritsch''' is a Star Wars CCG player who played at [[December 2001 Mannheim tournament]] on 8 December 2001 with no objective (Lars' Moisture Farm start, Qui-Gon), according to Vjeko Keskic's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d3164">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2001-12-12-mart-08-12-2001-mannheim-germanyd3164/ mart-08-12-2001-mannheim-germany], DeckTech (Vjeko "mighty_maul" Keskic, 12 December 2001). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2001-12-12-mart-08-12-2001-mannheim-germanyd3164/ GitHub Pages].</ref>
